source: “A token ID is an embedding.” An ID selects a row. The vector row is the embedding. “Each embedding dimension has one meaning.” Representations are generally distributed across dimensions and directions. “The same word always has the same embedding.”
zh: “令牌 ID 是一种嵌入。” ID 选择一行。向量行是嵌入。 “每个嵌入维度都有一个含义。”表示通常分布在维度和方向上。 “同一个词总是有相同的嵌入。”
